summary: Keep normal checkpoint state writes inside managed prepare/finalize transactions

replay.detail: No startup replay, history reconstruction or view migration.

schema.detail: No production schema, capture trigger or layout change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint preflight, state transitions, seal data and retention rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Public checkpoint method signatures are unchanged; installed prepare/finalize errors propagate through the existing result types.

downtime.detail: No deployment or restart is performed by this library change.

manual.detail: No source adapter is installed automatically.

recovery.detail: record_checkpoint_state, set_checkpoint_state and resume_checkpoints now execute and commit in a WriterGuard-managed transaction. Opt-in source adapters observe their checkpoint writes in the same prepare/finalize scope, rather than treating them as unsupported autocommit mutations. A hook failure rolls back the checkpoint update and its capture. Raw callers and other uncovered domains retain their source-gap fences.
